verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR/payroll/PEO product, so API-driven new-hire onboarding is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents only UI workflows (e.g., tax info is collected when employees enroll, and policy setup happens through the web navigation). Nothing shows a public API for creating employees, compensation, or tax setup, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup
